title: Affine coordinate correction probability
statement: For a function $f$ from the length-$n$ binary cube to signs, a coordinate $i$, and a Boolean value $b$, define the affine coordinate correction probability to be the proportion of cube vectors $y$ for which the local correction of $f$ in direction $e_i$ at $y$ equals the sign corresponding to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the length-n binary cube to signs
A coordinate i among the n coordinates
